name: agent-guardrails
description: On-chain, USD-denominated spending policies for AI agents: Chainlink-priced limits, self-scheduled timelocks via the Hedera Schedule Service, HCS intent logs, and a Hedera Agent Kit plugin with a Claude agent.

envVars.description: Only for `yarn agent:setup`: ECDSA key of a funded testnet account that will own the demo vault. Pass it inline; never commit it.
Only for `yarn agent:chat` (or run `ant auth login`). Agent settings live in packages/agent/.env, written by `yarn agent:setup`.

steps.text: AgentVault lets AI agents spend HBAR under USD limits the contract enforces. The dashboard works against the live testnet factory out of the box.

steps.label: Run the contract tests (unit + live Chainlink fork)
Fund a testnet account at the faucet, then bootstrap a vault, an agent and an HCS intent topic
Watch an agent hit all three lanes (instant, timelock, approval), with no LLM needed
Chat with a Claude agent that can only spend through the vault

steps.text: Deploy your own factory with {run:foundry:deploy} --network hedera_testnet. README.md walks through the architecture.
